chunks.text: Hari (Harisankar) is a Senior Cloud Architect at Cognizant Technology Solutions, based in Hyderabad, India. He has 15+ years of experience across enterprise infrastructure, cloud architecture, DevOps and AI-driven automation, having worked at Google Operations Center, Cisco Systems, SecureKloud, Qruize Technologies and Real Image before Cognizant.
You can reach Hari by email at pnharisankar@outlook.com or by phone at +91-9600124898. He is also on LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/pnhari and GitHub at github.com/meeturglider.
Hari is based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India (pin 500089). His career has taken him through Chennai earlier in life; he now works out of Hyderabad.

Hari has 15+ years of engineering experience: he started managing 100+ Linux servers at Real Image in 2011, moved into cloud with AWS at SecureKloud and Qruize, built DevOps platforms for Cisco Webex from 2017-2021, led 30+ GCP engineers at Google Operations Center from 2021-2024, managed a 200-engineer GCP operations merger at Cognizant in 2024-2025, and is now Senior Cloud Architect building AI-driven platforms on Google Cloud with Vertex AI and Gemini.

Since July 2025 Hari is Senior Cloud Architect at Cognizant Technology Solutions in Hyderabad. He leads AI-driven GCP transformation: designing enterprise applications with Google Cloud, Vertex AI and Gemini to automate support operations. Projected impact across his portfolio: 20% support-productivity gain and 10% reduction in consult rates. He also won the Transformation Spot Achiever award there.

Digital SME is Hari's retrieval-augmented support assistant at Cognizant: a Gemini Enterprise chatbot for Support Engineers that answers from the 'Golden dataset' instead of model memory, with citations. It includes an intelligent customer prioritization engine that flags high-risk accounts pre-escalation using historical signals (escalation rate, CES, stagnation) and an automated case-review pipeline replacing manual reviews of risky 'smoky' cases. Runs as FastAPI on Cloud Run with Vertex AI embeddings and vector search. Projected impact: 20% support-productivity gain, 10% fewer consult-rate cases via query deflection.

C.O.R.E (Comprehensive Online Review of Expertise) is Hari's assessment platform: Angular/PostgreSQL full-stack framework with Gemini 2.5 Flash driving computerized adaptive testing, an integrated Linux sandbox lab (VM/Docker) for hands-on terminal evaluations that self-destructs after completion, basic proctoring, behavioral analytics, and a Gemini-powered Behavioral AI simulator evaluating soft and technical skills across personas. Projected impact: 60% improvement in quality hiring and 35% advancement in critical Cloud Support metrics.

From August 2024 to July 2025 Hari was Senior Cloud Manager at Cognizant, guiding GCP operations teams across India and Europe. He completed the merger of GCP operations uniting 200 engineers across Romania and Israel, led the Transformation team infusing AI into workflows, and won the 'Raising the Bar - above and beyond' award.

Hari was Technical Lead at Google Operations Center (October 2021 - August 2024), leading and mentoring a team of 30+ engineers solving GCP issues across specializations. He helped top-tier GCP customers implement security best practices, presented business reviews to stakeholders, drove automation and FTE-savings initiatives, and won Best Performer (Bi-Annual Award) plus the Jump Starter TL recognition.

At Cisco Systems (October 2017 - October 2021) Hari was Technical Solution Architect handling a DevOps team for Webex: set up CI/CD via CloudBees Jenkins for all Webex deployments, independently converted a monolithic application to Docker-based microservices, built Dev/Staging environments on GCP with bastion access, and set up Envoy and Consul using Ansible and Terraform. He won Best Performer (Quarterly) and the Ninja Black Belt on Security.

At SecureKloud / 8K Miles (May 2016 - September 2017) Hari was Lead Cloud Engineer helping enterprise customers like Novartis adopt AWS: user account provisioning via CloudFormation and Python (boto), CloudWatch dashboards and custom metrics, Lambda automation, and AWS auditing/logging practices.

At Qruize Technologies (June 2015 - May 2016) Hari was Technical Lead responsible for CliQr support - a hybrid cloud management system - handling on-prem to AWS migrations, setting up OpenStack (Juno), and providing L2/L3 support for connectivity issues like VPC peering and VPN.

Hari started his career at Real Image (February 2011 - October 2014) as Senior Technical Support Engineer: accountable for encrypting critical files shared via cloud storage, managing 100+ Unix/RHEL servers, satellite-based patching, hardware troubleshooting (servers, routers, switches) and scripting away repetitive manual work.

Hari holds five certifications: Professional Cloud Architect (Google Cloud, 2024-2026), Professional Cloud Security Engineer (Google Cloud, 2025-2027), HashiCorp Certified Terraform Associate 003 (2024-2026), Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer (Google Cloud, 2022-2024) and AWS Professional Cloud Architect (2021-2023). The first three are currently active.

Hari's awards: Best Performer Bi-Annual Award and Jump Starter TL (Google Operations Center), Best Performer Quarterly and Ninja Black Belt on Security (Cisco Systems), Raising the Bar - Above and Beyond and Transformation Spot Achiever (Cognizant).
Hari holds a Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics and Communication from Francis Xavier Engineering College (2009).

Hari's core stack: Google Cloud Platform and AWS; Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and Ansible; containerization with Docker; CI/CD with Jenkins, Cloud Build and Lambda; scripting in Python and Shell/Bash; security operations with IAM, VPC and Security Command Center; API design and integration; and AI deployment with Vertex AI and Gemini. He also works with Angular frontends and PostgreSQL.

Hari's current focus is practical GenAI: retrieval-augmented assistants grounded in enterprise data (Digital SME), adaptive AI-driven assessments (C.O.R.E), and agentic automation workflows. His philosophy is grounding every answer in retrieved internal documents rather than trusting model memory alone, and keeping the corpus and model swappable to avoid lock-in.

Local AI Lab is Hari's self-hosted LLM inference setup: Ollama and Open WebUI running on local hardware, model comparison, quantization trade-offs, and studying where local inference genuinely beats an API call.
Personal Assistant using OpenClaw is Hari's Telegram-native AI automation project: agent workflows triggered from chat, with messaging as the interface rather than another dashboard.
ApplyPilot is Hari's ATS-aware resume tooling side project: keyword gap analysis against a target role, resume variant generation and application tracking.

Dory is me - Hari's slightly forgetful little guide living on this site! I answer questions about Hari by retrieving from his portfolio knowledge, optionally sharpened by an open LLM running on Groq. I was built with zero dependencies and no backend server.

This site (hari.is-a.dev, served from GitHub Pages at meeturglider.github.io) is Hari's hand-built portfolio: no frameworks, no bundler, no dependencies. Content lives in JSON files rendered by small vanilla-JS classes. It is keyboard accessible, respects reduced-motion preferences, and uses responsive images and system fonts to stay light. Source is on GitHub: meeturglider/meeturglider.github.io.

Elevate 360 is Hari's LLM-powered performance dashboard at Cognizant (currently building). It unifies associate performance data to proactively detect anomalies, explain TSR/SME/Lead scorecard fluctuations, raise real-time alerts on sensitive cases before they escalate, generate personalised coaching recommendations (integrating with Skillcraft), and automate team/site/specialisation comparison reports. Built with FastAPI on Cloud Run, Vertex AI, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Terraform and Angular.

Why Hari is worth hiring: fifteen-plus years that trace the exact arc modern platforms need — Linux infrastructure, network architecture at Cisco, cloud operations leadership at Google Operations Center, and now AI-driven GCP transformation as Senior Cloud Architect at Cognizant. He turns problem statements into shipped LLM systems (Digital SME, C.O.R.E, Elevate 360), carries projected impact of 20% support-productivity gain and 10% fewer consult cases, has won Best Performer awards at Cisco, GOC and Cognizant, and has mentored 30+ engineers along the way. Reachable at pnharisankar@outlook.com or +91-9600124898.

Hari's honest take on weaknesses: every stage of his career pushed him into unfamiliar water — Linux servers, then AWS, then DevOps at Cisco, then leading 30+ engineers at Google Operations Center, then GenAI architecture — and each time he started as a beginner and closed the gap fast, backed by five certifications (three currently active). His current stretch area is agentic automation workflows beyond prototypes. For a franker strengths-and-gaps conversation, email pnharisankar@outlook.com.

Hari's GenAI skill: he designs LLM-powered products end to end — retrieval-grounded assistants with citations (Digital SME), sandboxed AI assessment (C.O.R.E), and an LLM insight dashboard (Elevate 360). Working stack: Vertex AI, Gemini, GPT-OSS on Groq, embeddings and RAG orchestration on FastAPI. He treats grounding, evaluation and hallucination control as design requirements, not afterthoughts.

Hari's cloud architecture skill: a GCP specialist who designs serverless-first platforms — Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, BigQuery analytics splits, Identity-Aware Proxy edges — all reproducible through Terraform. Earlier chapters include AWS landing zones via CloudFormation, hybrid OpenStack work, enterprise IAM and security posture reviews at Google Operations Center, and CI/CD platform design at Cisco.

Hari's engineering skill: he ships working software himself, not just diagrams — Python/FastAPI services, Angular frontends, Docker packaging, Jenkins and Cloud Build pipelines. Proof: the site you're reading is his hand-built, zero-dependency JavaScript codebase, complete with its own TF-IDF retrieval engine powering this chatbot.

Hari's leadership skill: he leads the Transformation team infusing AI into support workflows at Cognizant, united a 200-engineer Google Cloud operation across Romania and Israel after a merger, and mentored 30+ cloud engineers at Google Operations Center. Recognition followed every chapter: Best Performer at Cisco, Bi-Annual Best Performer at GOC, and both Transformation Spot Achiever and Raising the Bar at Cognizant.
